In 1,39,936 cases property to the tune of Rs. 690-96 lakhs—about 23.4% of value of properiy stolen was recovered. The highest loss of property of Rs. 1131-07 lakhs was under the crime head ‘thefts’ and the highest recovery (Rs. 358-58 lakhs) was also made under this very head. Percentage recovery under dacoity was the least
